evidence_items.section: # Calvin > ## Boston trip (planned as of 2023-04-20; Frank Ocean tour stop as of 2023-05-31; personal visit July 2023)
evidence_items.text:
- Dave (apparently Boston-based) is offering to show him around — including Paradise Rock, House of Blues, and Fenway Park — and to take him to his favorite food spots; Calvin proposed grabbing a bite together when he is in Boston, and Dave agreed [S3T10][S3T15][S3T16] (see /memories/dave.md > ## Boston).
- Calvin is looking forward to trying the food in Boston with Dave and called it fun ("Can't wait to try out the food there with you") [S3T17].
- As of 2023-05-31, the Boston visit is part of the Frank Ocean tour: "Cool, can't wait for the tour with Frank!" — he's "buzzing to perform in Boston and see what it's like" and "Gonna be great playing for folks from home" (calling Boston's folks "from home" suggests it is where he's from, though not stated outright). He asked Dave what he thinks of the music scene there; Dave: it's "awesome — Tons of talented musicians and cool places to play," and he'll be there to cheer Calvin on (details in /memories/dave.md > ## Boston) [S7T15][S7T16].
- On 2023-06-09, said he has never been to Boston before but has heard the parks are amazing — "can't wait to visit next month" (i.e., July 2023); he wants to take walks in the Boston parks to experience their serenity and recharge, and asked Dave what cool things he remembers about them; shared a photo of a tree with pink flowers (likely from the album session); Dave's recollections of the Boston parks are in /memories/dave.md > ## Boston [S8T5][S8T7].
- As of 2023-08-22, said his tour ends soon and he's heading to Boston, and proposed meeting up with Dave then — "Maybe we can meet up then!" (renewing the earlier plan to meet in Boston, see above); Dave: "Fill me in on the details when you have them and let's meet up when you're here. Can't wait to hear all about everything!" (Note: the 2023-08-14 update described the Frank Ocean tour as already having ended with the Tokyo show, so this "tour ends soon" may be a continuation or a new tour — unconfirmed) [S15T10][S15T11].

- On 2023-04-20, caught up with Calvin ("long time no see"), who reported back from a Tokyo music festival; Dave reacted enthusiastically and asked what Calvin learned and where he sees his music taking him [S3T1][S3T2][S3T4][S3T6][S3T8].
- On 2023-05-31, caught up with Calvin ("been ages since we chatted"); congratulated Calvin on the Frank Ocean tour (Tokyo stop; details in /memories/calvin.md) [S7T1][S7T2]. Shared a photo of himself fixing a neighbor's car engine in a garage (details in ## Car maintenance shop) and told Calvin that working on cars is "definitely therapeutic"; Calvin said fixing cars calms him down "like meditating" and asked whether Dave has hobbies with the same satisfaction — Dave described his passion for fixing up things as more than a hobby, giving purpose and a sense of achievement (details in ## Hobbies and sense of purpose) [S7T2][S7T4][S7T5][S7T6]. The exchange ended with the two agreeing that transforming something and giving it a new life makes them feel like they "really achieved something" [S7T7][S7T8]. The 2023-05-31 conversation continued: Calvin echoed the "feeling of power and happiness" ("It's great to see what we created with all our hard work and ideas") [S7T9]; Dave asked whether Calvin always enjoys performing live (Calvin: it "always fuels my soul" — an "absolute high") [S7T10][S7T11], and Dave marveled at the artist-audience connection and the concert crowd photos Calvin shared (a large crowd taking pictures; a crowd watching a concert with bright lights; a band on stage), calling the atmosphere "off the charts" and saying music "brings people together ... like therapy for us all" [S7T12][S7T13][S7T14]; when Dave asked what's next for Calvin's music, Calvin named the Boston stop on the Frank Ocean tour, and Dave said he'll be there to cheer him on (details in ## Boston) [S7T14][S7T15][S7T16]. The conversation closed with Calvin thanking Dave for his support and saying he can't wait to experience the Boston music scene; Dave wished Calvin a great time in Boston and said he can't wait to hear all about it when he gets back, and Calvin promised to fill him in on all the details, signing off "See you soon!" [S7T17][S7T18][S7T19].
- On 2023-04-20, continued the catch-up: offered to show Calvin around Boston (Paradise Rock, House of Blues, Fenway Park), said he'll be in the front row when Calvin performs, and agreed to grab food at his favorite spots when Calvin visits (details in ## Boston) [S3T10][S3T15][S3T16]. Calvin shared a photo of his red sports car on display at a show, and Dave praised the work put into it [S3T13][S3T14].
- On 2023-05-01, caught up with Calvin ("long time no see") and announced that he had finally opened his own car maintenance shop — a dream come true and a step toward his other dream of working on classic cars; shared a photo of the shop (including a group of people in front of a car) and of the engine of the classic car he restored in 2022, and invited Calvin to come by; Calvin congratulated him, the conversation closed with mutual encouragement, and Calvin shared a photo of a gold necklace with a diamond pendant (details in ## Car maintenance shop, ## Classic cars, and /memories/calvin.md) [S4T1][S4T5][S4T7][S4T15][S4T16][S4T17][S4T22][S4T23][S4T24].
- On 2023-05-01, complimented Calvin's necklace and asked where he got it (Calvin: a gift from another artist, a reminder of why he keeps hustling as a musician); encouraged Calvin to keep pushing and making music, and the two agreed to keep each other motivated — "the road can be hard, but when we remember why we're doing it, it keeps us going" (in Calvin's words) [S4T25][S4T26][S4T27][S4T28].

evidence_items.section: # Calvin > ## Boston trip (planned as of 2023-04-20; Frank Ocean tour stop as of 2023-05-31; personal visit July 2023)
evidence_items.text:
- On 2023-11-13, told Dave he invited his old high school friend (the same friend he sightseeing'd with on 2023-10-24, see above) to see him perform in Boston — "It was insane!" — (recent as of 2023-11-13; the show date itself is not specified) (details in ## Relationships; Dave's side in the Relationships section of /memories/dave.md) [S29T1].
- On 2023-11-16, attended a "fancy gala" in Boston (told Dave about it on 2023-11-17, as "yesterday") and met some interesting people; shared a photo of himself and "the crew" (a photography of a group of men sitting on a rock next to a river) (Dave: "that event looks amazing! You all look awesome."; the Boston event — details in the 2023-11-17 entry of ## Relationships) [S30T2].
- On 2023-11-17, announced to Dave that he's accepted an invitation to perform at an upcoming show in Boston — "It's going to be an unforgettable musical experience!" — and said he can't wait to fill Dave in on all the details (no date or venue given; details in ## Music and in the 2023-11-17 entry of ## Relationships); Dave congratulated him on both the gala attendance and the upcoming performance and said he'd maybe catch one of his shows in Boston; Calvin: "I'll catch you when I'm in Boston" [S30T20][S30T21][S30T22] (Dave's side in the Boston and Music sections of /memories/dave.md).

- On 2023-05-16, still in Tokyo: shared a photo of the Tokyo night skyline taken "last night" (2023-05-15) — "the skyline was stunning"; Dave praised the shot and said he has to take a trip to Tokyo soon [S6T13][S6T14][S6T15][S6T16]. Calvin thanked Dave and said the city lights in Tokyo are amazing, encouraging Dave to visit — "it's awesome!" [S6T17].
- As of 2023-05-16, he has an upcoming performance in Tokyo "this month" (May 2023) he is "super excited" for — great to show his music to a whole new crowd and hopefully expand his following [S6T11].
- As of 2023-05-31, he had been touring with Frank Ocean the week before (~2023-05-22/28) and called it "wild"; the Tokyo show was "unreal" — the crowd was "insane" — and performing "felt so alive" he "can't find the words to express it"; the energy and love from the fans was "crazy" [S7T1][S7T3]. This was the Frank Ocean tour his planned Boston trip was to follow (see the Boston trip section below); as of 2023-05-31, Boston is a stop on this tour itself.
- On 2023-08-14, updated Dave that the tour with the well-known artist (the Frank Ocean tour, see above) ended with a show in Japan — the Tokyo show was "awesome": everyone was "so into it" when he played one of his songs and sang along, which he called "a magical moment"; feeling of performing and connecting with the audience "was unreal"; after the tour he had the opportunity to explore his new place (the Japanese mansion, see ## New home (2023-03-23)) — "it's like a dream come true!" [S14T4][S14T6].
- On 2023-08-31, when Dave asked how the end of the tour was, Calvin said the tour was amazing — he was "so pumped from all the energy from the audience" — and shared a photo of a crowd watching a concert with a large screen ("This pic totally captures how I felt. Such an amazing time!"); when Dave asked how it was performing on that big stage, Calvin said it was "a dream come true" — the energy was incredible, he "felt on top of the world", and it was "seriously surreal" [S16T2][S16T3][S16T4].

- On 2023-09-15, reacted to Dave's update that the night before (2023-09-14) he and his band had been jamming: "When everything just clicks during a jam session, it's such a great feeling." He asked if Dave had recordings of the sessions, and when Dave said no ("way too into it and totally forgot"), said "Aww, bummer! I would've loved to hear that music," adding that "some of the best memories can't be captured on video or audio" — "those special moments that stay in our hearts and minds." Dave also told him he attended a rock concert in Boston last weekend (~2023-09-09/10) with an "amazing atmosphere" (photo of a band on stage with bright lights); Calvin: "Rock concerts always have such an electrifying atmosphere!" (Dave's details in the Rock band and Music sections of /memories/dave.md) [S19T1][S19T2][S19T3][S19T4].
- Childhood song: one song "always makes [him] smile" — it played during a road trip with his dad, and they "had so much fun singing along to it"; on 2023-09-22, when Dave asked the name of the song, Calvin: "We used to rock a song by Tupac and Dr. Dre called 'California Love.' Ah, those were the days!"; Dave called the song a classic and invited Calvin to jam some music together, and Calvin agreed ("Yeah, let's do it! That would be awesome.") — the two are looking forward to an awesome jam session and creating something special (conversation flow in the 2023-09-22 entry of ## Relationships) [S20T6][S20T8][S20T9][S20T10][S20T16].
- On 2023-10-04, told Dave he met with some "incredible" artists in Boston the day before (2023-10-03) and talked about working together — the meeting was arranged through a mutual friend ("knew we'd be a great fit"); he found it "inspiring and exciting" because each artist has an individual style, and he's "stoked to collaborate with them on new music"; when Dave asked about it and to let him know how it goes, Calvin: "Can't wait to show you the final result." [S21T1][S21T2][S21T3].
- On 2023-10-04, when Dave asked what he works on to relax, Calvin shared a photo of a shiny orange car with its hood open and said he loves working on this project "to chill out" (a car project Calvin is working on himself — distinct from his own Ferrari, see ## New luxury car (Ferrari, 2023-03-26); makes sense given his long-standing finding that working on/fixing cars relaxes him "like meditation," see the 2023-05-31 entry in ## Relationships) [S21T3].
- On 2023-10-15, when Dave (feeling discouraged after his shop lost a deal to a competitor) asked how he stays motivated when faced with setbacks: "When setbacks come my way, I remind myself why I'm passionate about my goals. I rely on helpful people around me and take a break to recharge with my favorite activities. That always helps me get back to feeling motivated." (complements his earlier 2023-07-21 answer about staying motivated, see above) [S23T3][S23T4].

- On 2023-03-26, Dave congratulated him on the new car [S2T2][S2T6].
- On 2023-04-20, reconnected with Dave ("long time no see") and updated him on the Tokyo music festival; Dave reacted positively and asked where he sees his music going [S3T1][S3T2][S3T8].
- On 2023-04-20, Dave offered to show him around Boston and take him to his favorite food spots; Calvin proposed meeting up for a meal when he is in Boston (details in the Boston trip section above) [S3T10][S3T15][S3T16].
- The 2023-04-20 conversation closed with both of them looking forward to the visit — Calvin said he can't wait to try the food with Dave, and Dave replied he can't wait to show Calvin the amazing music and food in Boston, signing off "See you soon!" [S3T17][S3T18].
- On 2023-05-01, congratulated Dave on opening his own car maintenance shop — "Congrats on achieving your dream", said his hard work and dedication paid off, praised Dave's "guts and ambition" and told him to "keep it up", was enthusiastic about Dave going after classic cars ("Fulfilling your dreams is so important"), and called the photo of the restored car's engine "awesome" (details on Dave's shop in /memories/dave.md > ## Car maintenance shop) [S4T2][S4T4][S4T6][S4T8].
